name: Mizugame Hinata
source:
[u][b]"Heeey, [url=/c153765]Yamabuki-senpaaai[/url]~! Let’s drink together, pleaaase?"[/b][/u]

Protagonist's [b]kouhai[/b] who declared herself an Ultra Super Beauty upon her "university debut". 

She is a stylish university girl just like her fellows, and is easy to get along well with anyone—especially radiating the kind of vibe that makes older adults dote on her.

While polite and reserved with strangers, she drops all pretenses around close friends: [b]leveraging her self-aware cuteness as a tool to pester them (often annoyingly)[/b]. Yet she instantly blushes if someone flips the script by sincerely praising her.

[Translated from [url=https://www.hook-net.jp/weekend/character/]official website[/url]]
